facility.name: Kent International Academy
facility.programs_provided: Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1323 BROOKSTONE, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78248

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits: A child was observed to be sleeping in front of an exterior exit door.   Noted: this was corrected during the inspection when the child's mat was moved away from the door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits (26 TAC §746.2909(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: A slide structure with a platform of 27 inches was observed to not have the required six inches of loose-fill installed around the structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The reviewed operational policies were found to be missing items, such as, Suspension and expulsion of children, Safe sleep policy for infants from birth through 12 months old that is consistent with the rules in subchapter H, Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity that is consistent with Subchapter F, Parent rights that are consistent with the rules in Division 5, Procedures for parents to review and discuss with the child-care center director any questions or concerns about the policies and procedures of the child-care center, Instructions on how a parent may access the Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline, information regarding Preventing and responding to abuse and neglect of children, including: Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of issues regarding child abuse and neglect, including warning signs that a child may be a victim of abuse or neglect and factors indicating a child is at risk for abuse or neglect,  (C) Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of prevention techniques for child abuse and neglect, and (D) Strategies for coordination between the center and appropriate community organizations, Information on vaccine-preventable diseases for employees, Procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs. The policy must address the requirements outlined in ?746.2202, information regarding area being a gang-free zone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Securely Anchored: A play structure on the playground was observed to have the rail road ties that were anchored on one side sticking up and were not flush with the metal beam and the other side did not have the anchors at all. Noted: the anchors that were present were hammered down to be flush with the beam.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Securely Anchored (26 TAC §746.4601(5))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Licensing Parent Notification Poster: The licensing Parent Notification Poster, was not posted.   Noted: this was corrected when the poster was provided to the operation and was printed and posted on the parent bulletin board in the lobby area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Licensing Parent Notification Poster (26 TAC §746.401(7))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center: Current activity plans were not posted in two of the three classrooms.   Noted: this was corrected during the inspection when the current lesson plans were posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: The director did not have a current First Aid and CPR certification available for review. The certificate that was available was expired as of July 29, 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Three fire extinguisher's tags indicated that they had last been serviced August 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: One of the six children's files did not have a parent or physician siged health statement availalbe for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: Per the health and safety audit, the director's training was reviewed and there was no training certificate available for review in the required topic: Medication Administration.  Noted: this was corrected during inspection when the Medication Administration training for the current training year was used to cover the missing training in the evaluated year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: One caregiver, who has been employed over 90 days, did not have current First Aid Certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: There was not a current Form 2885 signed and avilalble for review. Noted: This was corrected during the inspection when the CPSC website was reviewed and form 2885 was signed and posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: An infant was sitting in a highchair without safety straps fastened.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: An infant under 12 months was observed to be sleeping in a crib with a blanket.   Noted: The blanket was removed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Recite: A caregiver was observed using her cell phone while caring for two children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: A caregiver was observed seated using her cell phone while the group was outside on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): One caregiver present did not have her notarized employment affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification: One staff file reviewed did not have a copy of their photo ID in the file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(9))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Cover All Stored Food: There was food stored in the refrigerator uncovered.   Noted: This was corrected during inspection when the food was disposed of.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Cover All Stored Food (26 TAC §746.3317(8))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: It was determined that an individual was present at the operation with children that did not have an active background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: One caregiver present did not have her notarized employment affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: In the pre-k classroom there was water conditioner liquid and cleaning supplies that were accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: One caregiver did not have the required 24 hours of annual training. The caregiver had 22 hours of training.   *A training certificate for two hours in communicable diseases from the current training year was added to make up for the missing 2 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One caregiver did not have required training in  food allergies and Communicable diseases.   *A training certificate in communicable diseases from the current training year was added to the previous training year to cover the topic.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Child must not go more than 3 hours: During the investigation process it was determined that lunch is being served passed three hours from the first meal/snack being served.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Child must not go more than 3 hours (26 TAC §746.3301(d))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: An infant age child (0-17 months) was being combined with children ranging in age from 2-5 years of age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Age-appropriate: Furniture in the toddler age room (18-24) was observed to not be age appropriate for the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Age-appropriate (26 TAC §746.2505(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Two individuals were able to be counted in ratio before receiving background check results.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: An infant was observed to be laid down into a crib with an additional mattress added.   Noted: this was corrected during the inspection when the second mattress was removed from the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Substitutes, volunteers, and contractors counted in ratio: An individual who has a background check of a volunteer was observed to be in a classroom alone with children.   Noted: this was corrected during inspection when the volunteer was removed from the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Substitutes, volunteers, and contractors counted in ratio (26 TAC §746.1401(c))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Two infant aged children were left in a room unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A person present at the operation did not have an active background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: The fence sourrounding the outdoor play area was observed to have areas that a child could push through to get to the other side.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The fence on the outdoor space was observed to have holes and metal extending out posing a risk of entrapment and puncturing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released: The emergency prepardenss plan did not include information on how care will continue in the even of an evacuation/relocation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The drills did not include necasssary information such as the time of the drill and the length of evacuation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a current health inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The operation has not been completing a monthing inspections of the building and grounds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A person present at the operation did not have an active background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Neglectful supervision occurred when a child was able get 3/4 of a mile away from the operation unnoticed for a minimum of 20 minutes. The child was found by a passerby unharmed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Substitutes, volunteers, and contractors counted in ratio: It was determined in the investigation process that an individual with a volunteer background check clearance, was left unsupervised with a group of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Substitutes, volunteers, and contractors counted in ratio (26 TAC §746.1401(c))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: An incident report was not written for an incident in which a child was able to leave the operation for a minimum of 20 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Supervision was compromised when a child was able to leave the operation's premises unnoticed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Through the investigation process it was determined that the person left in charge, in the director's absence, was not qualified as she did not have a current and clear background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: During diapering, a caregiver was observed to not change gloves before initiating a diaper change of another child. Noted: This was corrected during inspection when the caregiver removed her gloves and washed her hands before the next change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves (26 TAC §746.3505(c))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: During diapering, a caregiver was observed to not wash the child's hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: A caregiver was observed utilizing the handwashing sink to rinse bottles.   Noted: This was corrected during inspection when the caregiver was given information on why the handwashing sink cannot be used for cleaning bottles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: Caregiver stated that children age 12m- 2 years, who are all walking, are sleeping in cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: The cribs were observed to not have labels or a system  to identify the crib to the child that uses that crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: The classrooms being utilized were changed to accommodate different age groups before notifying licensing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: The bottles and cups observed were labeled with only the child's first name or not labeled at all. Did not include the required first name and last initial.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: A child was left alone in a classroom, when the caregiver left the room to open the door to allow inspectors in to the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: A current Fire inspection was unable to be provided for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two of the eight files observed did not include a health care provider statement, past the 12 months after the enrollment date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Spray bottles were observed to be on the changing table accessible to children. In the children's bathroom, a cabinet was not utilizing the installed safety locks, leaving the cleaning supplies stored in cabinet to be accessible to children.   Noted: this was made complaint during inspection when the cabinet was locked and the spray bottles were moved to a higher cabinet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates: Activity plans for the month were not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: The current employee list was not posted.   Noted: This was corrected when a list was typed and posted on the parent board.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Three of the eight children's files viewed did not include the required phone number or address for the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: There were items in the first aid kit that were missing. The items that were missing were:     Thermometer   Gloves
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: There were two caregivers at the operation that did not have their CPR and First Aid certification available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: The television in the Preschool room is not anchored to the shelf that it is set up.     The operation corrected this at inspection when the television was removed form the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))
